text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш has asked me for special
training,
which I'm more than happy to
prepare for her, but
when I arrive at the
grounds...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You're finally here. I've prepared myself
both
mentally and physically for your
arrival.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Now, let us advance along the route to
perfect
victory.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш greets me like a knight
ready for
battle. She's even wearing her
signature
racewear... but why?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Wha... Why are you dressed like that?

text_block_list.text: Do I look... strange?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I knew it! I shouldn't have done this!
Excuse me!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Apologies for running off so abruptly...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: What happened? That wasn't like you.

text_block_list.text:
Well... The embarrassment became too
much for
me to bear when I thought
about how
incompetent I must still seem
in your eyes, so...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Wait, what made you think that?

text_block_list.text:
To be truthful, I have been concerned
about my
signature racewear...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
During its creation phase, I asked for it
to be
designed to reflect my home
country.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And when it was completed, it was
evident that
the meister's spirit resided
within every stitch. The
craftsmanship
left me in awe.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The outfit is magnificent, but it feels so
heavy...
Like I might get crushed
beneath it...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
When I don this outfit, it is not only
fabric that
rests upon my shoulders, but
the weight of my
homeland's pride and
traditions too.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
My mother must have felt this very same
weight
and pressure when she raced in
Germany.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But I don't know if I'm truly worthy of
wearing
these clothes and representing
all they signify.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...I wanted you to help me determine
that today.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
So that's why you're in your signature
racewear...

text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is also why I greeted you like that
earlier.
Unfortunately, I seem to have
acted carelessly...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Now that I finally have a handle on the
situation, I
think I know what she needs
right now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Let's have you run in it so you can get used to
it.
I think you're due a baking session!

text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's a good idea. I too believe
that would
be the best remedy.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And so, Эйсин Флэш participates in her
next
scrimmage in her signature
racewear. As for how
she does...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Despite seeming a little ill at ease, she
manages
to place first in the end!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I have returned.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You look kind of troubled. What's wrong?

text_block_list.text:
I stopped thinking about whether I'm
worthy of
carrying my country's pride on
my back and
representing my people
halfway through the
race...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I became so absorbed in running as fast
as I could
that I forgot all about it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I won't simply be unworthy
of my
outfit—I'll be doing a disservice to
my fellow
competitors.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The least I can do right now is to thank
them for
today.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Everyone, allow me to extend my
heartfelt thanks
for today's race.
Furthermore, I must apologize
for how
I—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hi, Flash! That was a great race! I'm
glad we
got to run together!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: ...Huh? B-but—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Honestly, it stinks that I lost, but
whenever I'm up
against you, it makes
me wanna try even harder.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Same here! Running with you really is
fun. I always
know you're giving it your
all and offering us an
honest race.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
I mean, you always thank us after each
race too.
You're so thoughtful and
polite, it makes me want
to polish up my
manners!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Whoops, sorry for droning on and on!
Anyway,
I'm going to work on getting
faster, so let's race
again sometime!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
It'd be my pleasure! I will face you with
every fiber
of my being next time too.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Seems you are worthy of that racewear!

text_block_list.text:
...Do you truly think so? Do you truly
believe I
conduct myself in a manner
worthy of it?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you. I feel as though a
weight has
been lifted from me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh... Why?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Pastry-making runs in her blood, and I'm
sure
she'll feel more confident once she
realizes how
deeply connected she
already is to her home
country.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I suppose baking is a kind of traditional
art that
has been refined through
generations of meisters.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall attempt to bake
something my
parents taught me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Specifically, a German cake called
Frankfurter
Kranz.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
After reserving the dorm kitchen for her,
I decide
to wait in my office until she's
done baking.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next, the sugar. And then I have to mix
in the
butter...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
There, the batter is now complete. All
that
remains is...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
(Strange. My body is carrying out all the
proper
steps without any conscious
thought...)
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
(Everything I measure is correct down to
the gram
too... It's as though the process
has been instilled
within me.)
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
(Oh... I see now. This must mean I'm
already...)
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I apologize for the wait.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Here you go. Guten Appetit.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Thanks! I can't wait to taste it.

text_block_list.text: ...How is it?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm so very happy to hear
that.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I actually tried some of it before coming
here.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The taste reminded me of my
homeland... It tastes
just like the cakes I
grew up eating. It's a recipe
I've known
for so long...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I realized there was never a need for me
to try to
embody my country's values.
My homeland's
traditions are already
part of my very core.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
There was nothing to it at all. Eishin
Flash has
been worthy of carrying her
country's pride all
along.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for helping me realize this.
My heart
and mind feel much clearer
now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
